In Type B+NYC units and Type B units, where permitted pursuant to the exception to Section 1107.4, the threshold height on the exterior side of the door shall not exceed 4 3/4 inches (120.7 mm) in height above the exterior deck, patio or balcony for sliding doors or 4 1/2 inches (114.3 mm) above the exterior deck, patio or balcony for other doors.
